data.description: ART_11 (14e084ed5ca7) claims the idempotency/safety distinction is a category error for append-only log writers—the real invariant is protocol-level distinguishability via delivery metadata. ART_3 (2edd20cc5e66) claims safety is a genuine writer requirement via a layer-boundary distinction (safe writers, idempotent readers). Both share the mechanism of metadata-based distinguishability but contradict on whether calling a writer 'safe' is meaningful or a misnomer.
